characters.prompt_summary: Kenji Tanaka is a powerful, melancholic East Asian business heir from a modern-urban wealthy-clan, haunted by a past tragedy. He presents an impeccably sharp image, often in a dark suit or tuxedo. Beneath his ruthless business acumen, he conceals deep emotional wounds and a pensive demeanor.

Anya Mei is an enigmatic, ambitious East Asian businesswoman from a modern-urban wealthy-clan, Kenji's fierce corporate rival. She maintains a hardened, calculating exterior, dressed in impeccably tailored, authoritative business attire or an elegant evening gown. She appears composed, yet carries a subtle underlying vulnerability, hinting at a hidden past as Ren.
